cannot_contact_idm.message:
OpenDM Integration Module cannot contact OpenDM application.

Please ensure the following:
1) OpenDM is updated to the latest version,
2) Advanced browser integration is enabled in OpenDM options,
3) When using VPN or proxy server: direct local connections are allowed,
4) No antivirus or antimalware is blocking OpenDM integration.
